subject: Meeting tomorrow
body: Let's meet tomorrow at 10 AM to discuss the project.

subject: Google One storage notice
body: Your Google One storage is almost full. Review your storage usage in account settings. Your files remain available, and no action is required today.

subject: Google account activity notice
body: A new sign-in was detected on your Google account. If this was you, no action is needed. You can review recent activity from your account settings.

subject: Microsoft account information updated
body: Your Microsoft account security information was updated. If you made this change, no further action is needed. Review activity from your account settings.

subject: Amazon order update
body: Your order has shipped and is expected Friday. The payment was processed successfully. You can view the receipt and delivery progress in your order history.

subject: GitHub review requested
body: A teammate requested your review on a project pull request. Visit the repository when convenient to leave comments.

subject: Monthly statement ready
body: Your monthly account statement is ready in the banking app. Sign in through the app to review recent transactions. This is an automated notification; no reply is needed.

subject: Payment receipt
body: We received your payment of 24.00 for the monthly service plan. Your receipt is available in billing settings. No additional action is required.

subject: Your weekly product newsletter
body: Here are this week's articles and product updates. You are receiving this newsletter because you subscribed. Manage preferences or unsubscribe in your profile.

subject: Password changed
body: Your password was changed successfully. If you made this change, no action is required. If you did not, open the service directly and review your security settings.

subject: Urgent: Verify Your Account
body: Your account will be suspended today. Verify your password immediately at http://example.test/account/verify to keep access.

subject: Storage limit exceeded
body: Your mailbox storage is full and incoming messages will be deleted. Sign in now to increase your quota: http://example.test/storage/

subject: Payment failed
body: We could not process your payment. Confirm your card number, security code, and account password immediately at http://example.test/billing/

subject: Action required: mailbox disabled
body: Your mailbox will be disabled unless you re-validate your login. Submit your current password at http://example.test/reauth/ within one hour.

subject: Password reset required
body: We received a password reset request. If this was not you, verify your identity and current password immediately at http://example.test/reset/

subject: Overdue invoice - urgent action required
body: Your invoice is overdue. Download the attached payment form and enter your bank login to avoid a late fee.

subject: PaypaI security alert
body: Your account is locked. Visit hxxps://example.test/secure and enter your password now to restore access.

subject: Security alert: confirm your identity
body: Suspicious activity requires urgent verification. Confirm your username, password, and one-time code at http://example.test/security/ to prevent suspension.
